name: health-monitor-frontend
description: Release Health Monitor - Frontend with Sentry Integration

scripts.sentry:release: node -e "const v=process.env.SENTRY_RELEASE||'health-monitor-frontend@'+require('./package.json').version; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); execSync('npx @sentry/cli releases new '+v,{stdio:'inherit'}); execSync('npx @sentry/cli releases files '+v+' upload-sourcemaps ./dist --rewrite',{stdio:'inherit'}); execSync('npx @sentry/cli releases finalize '+v,{stdio:'inherit'});"
